identity.kind: PS4 slim console (special edition claimed by seller)

claims.claim: Very clean ps4 slim special edition with follow come controller and other accessories
claims.evidence: Photo 0 only shows the console; no controller/accessories are visible, and 'special edition' text/model is not readable.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired
claims.evidence: No seals/stickers/inspection photos or internal/serial verification shown.
No temperature/usage test or gameplay/benchmark footage shown.
No close-up of ports or demonstration of HDMI/USB/audio working shown.

claims.claim: Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt
claims.evidence: No pads/controllers or receipt are shown in photo 0.

risks.risk: Exact PS4 model/special edition cannot be confirmed from the photo; pricing depends on model and edition.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the console label showing the full model code (e.g., CUH-xxxx) and serial number (you can blur serial if needed but keep model code readable).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic PS4 slim console with unknown edition and unknown condition of included items.

risks.risk: Accessories may be missing or different from what’s claimed (controller, cables, pads, receipt).
risks.proof: A single photo showing all included items laid out (console + controller(s) + cables + any discs/pads + receipt).
risks.if_unproven: Price as console only (no guaranteed accessories/receipt).

risks.risk: Port faults (HDMI/USB/audio/Ethernet) or controller pairing issues may exist even if the console looks clean.
risks.proof: Short video showing: HDMI connected to TV with boot screen, at least 2 USB ports tested with a device, and controller connected/working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested / worst-case: ports/controllers may require repair.

risks.risk: Overheating or fan issues may not be visible in a still photo.
risks.proof: Video of 15–20 minutes gameplay or a stress test with the fan sound audible (and ideally a temperature readout if available).
risks.if_unproven: Price as potential overheating risk (treated as needing service).

risks.risk: Console may have been opened/serviced or has replaced parts (seller says never opened).
risks.proof: Photos of warranty/void stickers (if any) and a close-up of the underside/serial area; optionally a photo of internal inspection only if seller is willing.

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the console label with the full PS4 model code (CUH-xxxx) readable.
Photo of all included accessories laid out (controller(s), cables, pads, and receipt).
Short video: boot to home screen + HDMI working + at least two USB ports tested + controller connected and responding.
Video showing the console running for 15–20 minutes (fan noise/heat check).
response.reason: From photo 0, I can only confirm it’s a PS4 slim-looking console; the special edition, included controller/accessories, receipt, and functional claims (ports/overheating) are not verifiable remotely. Missing this proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
